evidenceIntegrity.sharedRenderCaveat: The enclosing shared workflow is not relabeled PASS. These dispositions rely only on the exact scoped Wall 5-8 bindings and usable real-pixel card/detail evidence.

decisions.name: Garden Garland
decisions.reason: Actual detail pixels show two visible wall hooks, braided cord, layered painted-wood/paper/fabric pieces, clips and strong separated cast shadows. The handmade dimensional construction unmistakably reads as wall decor, Art Attack is carried by tactile craft materials rather than a palette swap, and the asymmetric garland silhouette remains legible in the actual Store card.

decisions.name: Planet Map
decisions.reason: Actual pixels show a deep rigid midnight plaque/frame with obvious side thickness, mounting/standoff hardware, raised brass orbital rings, pearl-like planets and a clear wall cast shadow. Star Luxe reads through restrained polished metal, dark gloss and pearlescent detail while staying card-readable and distinct from the other Wall items.

decisions.name: Skate Poster
decisions.reason: The real-pixel detail has a thick dimensional navy frame, visible hanging brackets/hardware, glazing/inset depth and a strong wall shadow. The no-text skateboard/half-pipe graphic has high neon contrast that survives the Store card scale, fits Midnight Neon Tier 3, and is visually distinct from the plaque, garland and window concepts.

decisions.name: Ocean Window
decisions.reason: The Candy Core enamel, fasteners, thick nested glass/jamb layers, water depth and card readability are strong, but the exact pixels do not unmistakably read as a wall-mounted/recessed window. In both card and detail views the unit appears supported by a horizontal floor/table plane with a long ground-contact shadow, so it can read as a freestanding aquarium/window module instead of architecture mounted into a vertical wall.
decisions.rework: Preserve the current Candy Core material palette, rounded thick frame, fasteners and layered ocean/glass depth. Change only the mounting/composition defect: show the unit visibly embedded in or attached to a continuous vertical wall plane, with wall-normal recess/standoff/contact shadow and no supporting horizontal surface or floor-contact shadow. Keep the same Tier-3 richness and small-card silhouette.
